warning_text: Heat wave conditions likely at isolated pockets over north interior Tamil Nadu with temperatures 3-5 deg C above normal.
Red alert issued: Extremely heavy rainfall (>204 mm) and squally winds associated with low pressure area over Southwest Bay of Bengal.
Cyclone Fengal alert: Deep depression over SW Bay of Bengal crossing Tamil Nadu coast between Karaikal and Mahabalipuram.
Severe flood warning: Cyclonic circulation inducing continuous torrential downpours exceeding 300 mm over southern districts.
Thunderstorm with lightning and gusty winds (30-40 kmph) likely over central and southern interior Tamil Nadu.
